{{Quote|I don't care if the order came from the Emperor himself&mdash;you tell Imperial Center that we're running at capacity out here! If filling this sector with more capital ships is so important, then build more refineries on this godforsaken rock!|[[Arno D'Vox]]|<ref name="Rebellion 11">[[Rebellion 11|''Rebellion'' 11]]</ref>}}
This '''unidentified planet''' housed [[Bannistar Station]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] refueling station. The station's refineries were placed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] surface, while the rest of the station was located high above. During the [[Attack on Bannistar Station]], much of the station was destroyed and at least one [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] crashed on the planet.

==History==
This planet was explored sometime between [[3000 BBY]] and [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]].

==Inhabitants==
By [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], this planet boasted a population of 10 million to 100 million [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]].
